scan_linter_check.description:
Flags server-side query() calls on a GlideRecord or GlideRecordSecure created in the same function with a literal table name, when no condition (addQuery, addEncodedQuery, addActiveQuery, addInactiveQuery, addNullQuery, addNotNullQuery, addJoinQuery) and no setLimit() or chooseWindow() is applied before the query.
Not flagged: GlideAggregate, get(), tables named at run time, tables listed in the system property ecs.gr.small_tables (comma-separated, empty by default), and queries whose conditions exist but cannot be verified (run-time values, conditions on some code paths only, GlideRecords passed to other code first). An unfiltered query is not always a defect: some tables are small by design, and some jobs legitimately process every record. Client-only scripts are skipped.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-GR-001: GlideRecord query with no conditions
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Add query conditions for the records actually needed. To read one record use get() or setLimit(1); to count use GlideAggregate. If the table is small by design, add it to the system property ecs.gr.small_tables; otherwise mute the finding with a reason.
scan_linter_check.short_description: query() with no conditions or limit reads every record in the table.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-GR-001: GlideRecord query with no conditions
